name: Tetherow
architects: David McLay Kidd (opened 2008); playability changes 2014-2018 under the club (greens 7 and 17 enlarged, bunkers filled on 1, 5 and 13, waste areas for native areas)

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth), exportImage f=image at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 630400-632400 / y 4875630-4877880, fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31 (release data-tetherow, dogami_dtm_ft.tif). The lidar under it is the 2010 OLC Deschutes / Newberry flights (USGS 3DEP lists OR_DESCHUTES_NEWBERRY_CRATER_OLC_2010 and OR_DESCHUTES_OLC_2009_2011 over the box; no newer project)

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (highest hit minus bare earth), exportImage f=image at 1 m in EPSG:32610, same box, fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31 (release data-tetherow, dogami_chm_ft.tif); 2010 flight
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

ortho.source: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024 (OSIP_2024_WM), two JPEG exportImage halves at 0.5 m placed by their request boxes (intake.py ortho), fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31 (release data-tetherow)

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 780645556) box 1,352 x 1,638 m, x 630721-632073 / y 4875936-4877574, plus 205-220 m of scenery each side, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred

scorecard_source: Stymie (stymie.golf, Tetherow Golf Club, read 2026-10-31): per-hole yardages for every set, par, men's handicap row, ratings. Its Kidd row (7,298) matches 18Birdies' Kidd per-hole card and its ratings (75.2/150, Black 73.7/145) match 18Birdies'; 18Birdies totals Black 6,955. The handicap row matches 18Birdies and OpenGolfAPI. GolfPass's card is older (Kidd 7,283 with 17 at 167; Black 6,933; a different handicap row; ratings 74.9/141) and is not used. No club card online was found. Unverified third-party card. Sage_Red and Red ratings are the women's (the men's rows on Stymie are the Junior/Red 65.2 ones, unlabeled).
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
notes: Developer's calls 2026-10-30 (overnight): build the back tees (Kidd) and the set one forward of them (Black; the card has no Blue); Black is the default. All water red; the OSM boundary is out of bounds; the driving range is out of bounds; fairway trees removed. Wind 1-9 mph: inland high desert at 3,700-3,900 ft on the east flank of the Cascades, afternoon breezes but no sea wind.

gorse.note: desert shrubs, not gorse: sage, bitterbrush and manzanita from the OSIP 2024 photo (pipeline/gorse.py; its colour rule tuned to the dark shrubs in the grey-tan native ground: smoothed V 45-105, G-R above -8, B-G -30 to +2; the irrigated turf has B-G near -70), 6 m apart, kept 2 m off mown grass; no penal ground (bushes only; course chat's call, 2026-10-31); drawn by the theme's desert_bush painter
